current_diagnostics.phase_lift_scope: FF-guided lift uses native FF phases and real F(4)=1+sum cot(phi_j/2)*ImF_j/M. It preserves S, but does not certify continuity, Watson saturation, zeros or PV off-node winding.
current_diagnostics.scope: Native low-energy S0/P1; diagnostics, not extra constraints or continuum/phase error bounds
